semiconductor_relevance: High — KHJ Technology specializes in semiconductor processing tapes, which are critical for various stages of semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Shenzhen KHJ Technology Co., Ltd is a leading manufacturer of ESD adhesive tape and SMT splice tape, providing essential materials for the semiconductor and electronic manufacturing industries. With over 20 years of experience, they offer a range of anti-static and high-temperature resistant tapes that are widely recognized in the market.

regional_presence.China: KHJ Technology has established long-term cooperation with numerous domestic and foreign electronic manufacturing factories.
